pilot: Pilot build. The 1,500 gold flare stars of a 1,500-star test sample in sectors 52 and 55. The numbers below describe this sample, not the full catalogue. Distances and flare energies are not shown yet: the Gaia astrometry step was not run for this sample.

captions.cap_sky: The 1,500 flare stars on the sky (point size grows with the number of flares).
captions.cap_cmd: Gaia colour against apparent G magnitude, coloured by flare rate (per day of TESS coverage).
captions.cap_ed: Equivalent durations of 2,510 flares; complex flares in red.
captions.cap_stack: 1,785 simple flares at peak S/N ≥ 10 stacked: time in units of each flare’s decay half-time, flux relative to its brightest frame, with the median (white) and the Davenport et al. (2014) template (dashed).
